rebuttal_or_critique: I acknowledge the arguments for a 50 bps hike, as it aligns with the necessity to move toward a neutral real rate in an environment where CPI inflation at 7.01% is persistently above our band. While I have previously advocated for a calibrated approach to protect growth, the positive output gap of 0.40% and excess system liquidity of 190,000 crore INR suggest that the economy can withstand this adjustment. I find the arguments for 50 bps more compelling than 25 bps because a front-loaded move helps to better anchor inflation expectations amidst global spillovers and exchange rate pressures, without stifling the recovery, provided we remain data-dependent.
